end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming soil and leaf-litter animals and explaining how earthworms help soil. They described tunnels letting air and water in; the mix-up that earthworms harm soil was corrected later by discussing their helpful role and dead leaves becoming rich soil. At home, ask Pihu to name animals seen under leaves or stones without touching them, then return the leaves and wash hands.
